name: The Hinge & The Near Field
description: My Substack. Essays on AI and work, democracy and power, and the near future; near-future scenarios; and Light Shines Through, the first novel in The Shattered World series, serialized chapter by chapter.

name: The Daily Whatever Show
description: Satire and news commentary I co-host and co-own with Dana DuBois, my closest friend for more than four decades. Generational politics, current events, the felt experience of being Gen X right now. Mostly an excuse to keep showing up for each other.

name: The Shattered World
description: My speculative-fiction series. Book One, Light Shines Through, is serializing chapter by chapter on The Hinge & The Near Field. Book Two, Any Open Door, is in development.

name: Moondark
description: A web app that tells you whether the Moon is void of course right now, for astrologers, witches, and anyone who has learned the hard way not to schedule important things during a void Moon. Phone app coming.

name: alpacalunch
description: A T-shirt and merch shop for rebels, ranters, and smartasses: funny, political, occasionally vulgar, and proudly left-leaning. Yes, the name is one word.

name: genXy
description: A generational-writing publication on Medium, where I write alongside other Gen X voices.

name: Peptidings
description: A serious publication on peptide science: careful sourcing, no hype. On hiatus for now.
